descriptions.ael: Uses an LLM to initialize, cross over and mutate algorithms represented by a short explanation and Python code. Executed fitness scores determine which candidates remain in the population.
descriptions.eoh: Evolves heuristics as paired natural-language ideas and executable code. LLM prompts generate exploratory variations, parameter changes and simplifications, while measured fitness guides population selection.
descriptions.l-autoda: Evolves the proposal function inside a fixed random-walk framework for decision-based adversarial attacks. LLM crossover and mutation generate candidates that are scored by attack distance under a query budget.
descriptions.reevo: Combines an LLM code generator with a reflector that compares candidate heuristics. Short-term comparisons and accumulated reflections guide crossover and mutation of the current best program.
descriptions.funbo: Uses a FunSearch-style island archive to evolve acquisition functions for Bayesian optimization. Each candidate is evaluated through complete optimization runs, and scored programs become examples for subsequent LLM proposals.
descriptions.meoh: Evolves heuristics against solution quality and running time together. Parent selection combines Pareto dominance with code dissimilarity, producing a set of trade-off solutions.
descriptions.hsevo: Combines LLM reflection, crossover and mutation with numerical harmony search. The LLM changes heuristic code and exposes tunable parameters that a separate optimizer refines.
descriptions.mcts-ahd: Searches a tree of executable heuristics using Monte Carlo tree search. LLM operators create or revise code, while aligned descriptions and evaluation scores inform later expansions.
descriptions.cae: Co-evolves the modules and dependency structure of complete algorithmic solutions. LLM reflection and recombination propose functional and structural changes, followed by validation and fitness-based selection.
descriptions.funsearch-re-implementation: Reimplements FunSearch as an island-based search over Python priority functions. An LLM extends prompts containing scored programs while the surrounding solver and evaluator remain fixed.
descriptions.llm-lex: Uses a multimodal LLM to propose symbolic function forms from plots and parent expressions. Numerical optimization fits their free parameters; a related pipeline replaces learned Kolmogorov–Arnold network functions with symbolic expressions.
descriptions.redahd: Searches for problem reductions alongside the heuristics used to solve the reduced problems. An LLM generates instance and solution transformations, then revises them when the associated heuristic search stalls.
descriptions.eoh-s: Evolves complementary sets of heuristics using performance vectors across problem instances. Local improvement and crossover propose candidates, and greedy selection retains a set whose members cover different instances.
descriptions.ready: Evolves reward functions for reinforcement-learning-based black-box optimizers in separate task niches. Reflections on failures and search history guide changes, with reward ideas transferred between niches.
descriptions.a2dept: Evolves complete solver programs in a tree of evaluated candidates. Adaptive mutation and crossover are combined with acceptance rules and a maintenance loop that implements missing helpers and removes dead code.
descriptions.funl2o: Evolves executable feature functions for existing learning-to-optimize pipelines. A semantic contract validates each proposal before the host model is retrained and the resulting pipeline is evaluated.
descriptions.pdr: Uses an LLM to reformulate constraint-programming models while checking solution validity against a baseline. Past attempts are selected for context using their diversity in per-instance runtime behavior.
descriptions.dga2d: Represents an algorithm as a directed graph of operators with alternative code implementations. A learned policy samples pipelines, and evaluation-derived credit guides changes to operator implementations and graph edges.
descriptions.alphaevolve: Combines an LLM ensemble, program archives and executable evaluators to evolve code. Candidate edits draw on prior programs and scores, while island and quality-diversity mechanisms organize the search.
descriptions.satlution: Uses planning and coding agents to revise complete SAT-solver repositories. Compilation, smoke tests, external solution checks and benchmark runs feed a champion–challenger development cycle.
descriptions.shinkaevolve: Evolves programs through an island archive, LLM edits and crossover. Novelty filtering, accumulated search notes and bandit-based model selection guide subsequent proposals.
descriptions.codeevolve: Co-evolves programs and their generation prompts across island populations. An LLM ensemble proposes edits using ancestry and other solutions, with quality-diversity archives and migration retaining candidates.
descriptions.the-station: Provides a shared research environment where agents choose their own actions, submit code for evaluation and exchange notes and publications. Persistent memory connects successive agents within a lineage.
descriptions.loongflow: Organizes program evolution into planning, execution and summarization stages. Plans and outcome summaries become lineage memory that guides later proposals within an island-based program archive.
descriptions.magellan: Uses AlphaEvolve to revise compiler heuristics and evaluates rebuilt compilers on benchmark workloads. A separate autotuner can optimize numerical parameters exposed by the generated policy.
descriptions.adaevolve: Adapts an island-based program search using a shared signal of recent improvement. The controller adjusts local exploration, allocates evaluations between islands and requests new LLM search tactics during stagnation.
descriptions.evox: Runs program evolution inside an outer loop that revises the search strategy itself. The evolving strategy controls candidate storage and sampling, while the accumulated program database survives strategy changes.
descriptions.rankevolve: Evolves complete lexical retrieval scoring programs with LLM-generated edits. Island populations and quality-diversity archives retain candidates evaluated on recall and ranking metrics across datasets.
descriptions.avo: Uses a tool-using coding agent as the variation operator for CUDA-kernel optimization. The agent chooses what to inspect, modify and evaluate, drawing on persistent technical knowledge and prior versions.
descriptions.coral: Lets persistent coding agents conduct search in isolated worktrees connected by shared attempts, notes and skills. A hidden evaluator scores submissions, while periodic prompts encourage reflection and changes of direction.
descriptions.base: Allocates a fixed budget of LLM calls across parallel evolutionary search trajectories. A multi-armed bandit chooses which trajectory receives the next call based on observed progress.
descriptions.codeevolve-salesforce: Uses runtime profiles to select code components for evolutionary optimization. LLM edits are evaluated through a cascade of checks, with neighboring components supplied as context and repair agents handling failed candidates.
descriptions.eurekagent: Coordinates coding-agent sessions through a shared environment, persistent artifacts and evaluation services. Proposal rounds produce hypotheses that parallel implementation sessions explore under explicit time and cost budgets.
descriptions.agentic-optimization: Lets coding agents choose their own search steps while a server owns task definitions, evaluation and artifact snapshots. Public verification, authoritative submissions and persistent research records connect otherwise disposable worker sessions.
descriptions.adas: Uses a meta-agent to write new agent programs from an archive of previous designs and evaluation results. Self-reflection and execution feedback guide revisions before candidates are added to the archive.
descriptions.aflow: Searches for agent workflows represented as Python code connecting LLM calls and predefined operators. A tree-search procedure proposes individual workflow changes and accumulates experience from validation runs.
descriptions.agentsquare: Searches agents assembled from planning, reasoning, tool-use and memory modules. An LLM writes new modules and recombines existing ones, using execution results and an in-context performance predictor.
descriptions.g-del-agent: Allows an agent to inspect and modify its own Python code during execution, including its self-improvement routine. A task environment and utility function provide feedback for recursive revisions.
descriptions.evoflow: Evolves populations of agent workflows with different models, prompts and operator structures. Query-specific retrieval selects parents, while crossover, mutation and Pareto selection balance task performance and execution cost.
descriptions.sica: Selects an agent from an archive to inspect previous results and revise its own codebase. New versions are evaluated using a utility function that combines task performance, cost and execution time.
descriptions.dgm: Evolves coding agents that modify their own tools and workflow code. An archive supplies parents, evaluation logs inform proposed changes, and coding benchmarks assess the resulting agent versions.
descriptions.polymath: Optimizes both a graph of subtasks and the executable agent workflow used for each subtask. Execution monitoring and LLM-based feedback guide graph restructuring and code evolution during task solving.
descriptions.gea: Evolves groups of coding agents using shared execution traces and improvement experience. Reflections over the pooled evidence guide framework-level patches, and evaluated descendants join a common archive.
descriptions.hyperagents: Combines a task agent and a meta-agent in an editable program. Archive-based evolution lets the meta-agent revise both task-solving behavior and the code responsible for future modifications.
descriptions.meta-harness: Searches over code that controls a frozen model's prompts, retrieval, memory and orchestration. A coding agent inspects archived candidates, scores and execution traces before proposing new harnesses for evaluation.
descriptions.aevo: Alternates between meta-level changes to an evolution mechanism and runs of that mechanism. The meta-agent can edit search procedures or an agent's operating context while a protected evaluator measures candidates.
descriptions.rqgm: Co-evolves task agents and learned evaluators within an archive-based search. Evaluators remain fixed during each epoch, with replacements checked against a ground-truth anchor and affected utility records selectively cleared.
descriptions.darwinian-evolver: Evolves code and text using fitness-weighted parent sampling and LLM mutations informed by failure cases and earlier changes. Separate feedback and scoring sets support selection, with optional checks before full evaluation.
descriptions.flowscout: Builds initial tool-using workflows from execution logs, then searches over their topology and prompts. Compiled workflows produce node-level feedback that guides subsequent tree-search expansions.
descriptions.hsi: Separates a task harness, an evolver that revises it and a meta-evolver that revises the evolution strategy. These nested changes operate through fixed interfaces and an unchanged outer evaluation framework.
descriptions.protegi: Turns prompt failures into natural-language critiques that guide revised prompts. Beam search explores these revisions, while bandit-style evaluation selects candidates without fully evaluating every proposal.
descriptions.evoprompt: Uses LLMs as variation operators for a population of instruction prompts. Genetic-algorithm and differential-evolution variants select prompts using development-set performance.
descriptions.promptbreeder: Co-evolves task prompts and the mutation prompts used to rewrite them. Tournament selection and several LLM-based mutation operators retain prompt combinations based on task accuracy.
descriptions.promptagent: Treats prompt optimization as Monte Carlo tree search. An optimizer LLM interprets errors from task examples and proposes revised prompts, with held-out performance guiding tree expansion.
descriptions.phaseevo: Optimizes instructions and demonstrations together through distinct phases of local feedback, population fusion and semantic mutation. Candidate performance determines selection and transitions between phases.
descriptions.mipro: Optimizes instructions and demonstration sets for modules in a multi-stage language-model program. Bootstrapped examples and grounded instruction proposals feed a Bayesian search over module configurations.
descriptions.gaapo: Combines several prompt-generation strategies, including error-driven revision, mutation, few-shot examples and crossover. Validation scores and adaptive evaluation procedures select parents for the next generation.
descriptions.deevo: Evolves prompts through pairwise debates over their outputs and Elo-based selection. Debate transcripts inform crossover, followed by instruction mutations and selection across new and existing prompts.
descriptions.gepa: Uses execution traces and textual feedback to reflectively revise instructions in multi-module AI systems. A Pareto-based candidate pool preserves complementary solutions, with occasional merges across successful lineages.
descriptions.evoskill: Turns failure traces into new or revised skill folders containing instructions and optional scripts. Executor, proposer and builder roles produce candidates that are evaluated against a frontier of existing skill sets.
descriptions.algoevolve: Evolves trading programs within an inner search loop and the search prompt in an outer loop. Reports from each program search guide changes to a structured prompt genome.
descriptions.sepo: Applies prompt optimization to the prompt optimizer itself. An initial evolutionary stage develops the optimizer's system prompt, which is then fixed while it optimizes a target agent's prompt.
descriptions.pairwise-validator: Replaces scalar acceptance scores in an evolution loop with LLM comparisons between parent and child outputs. Adaptive judging criteria or Elo ratings support candidate acceptance and parent selection.
descriptions.text2reward: Generates executable reward functions from task instructions and a structured description of the environment. Interpreter errors and optional human feedback on policy rollouts guide further revisions.
descriptions.eureka: Generates reward-function code from environment source and task descriptions. Reinforcement-learning runs evaluate each candidate, and summaries of reward components and outcomes guide the next proposals.
descriptions.revolve: Evolves reward functions across island populations using LLM mutation and crossover. Human preferences over policy-rollout videos provide Elo-based fitness and feedback for subsequent reward proposals.
descriptions.dreureka: Combines reward-function evolution with automatic construction of domain-randomization configurations. Policy tests estimate feasible simulator-parameter ranges, which constrain the configurations proposed by an LLM.
descriptions.stride: Iteratively samples reward functions and trains reinforcement-learning policies to evaluate them. Feedback on reward components and policy behavior guides refinement around the best candidate.
descriptions.llm-evolved-rl-algorithms: Evolves executable reinforcement-learning update rules within a fixed training framework. LLM mutation and crossover revise loss computations and auxiliary state, while complete policy-training runs supply fitness.
descriptions.limen: Jointly evolves observation and reward functions for reinforcement-learning environments. Program archives retain validated interfaces according to the performance of policies trained with them.
descriptions.lasr: Augments symbolic regression with LLM-based initialization, mutation and crossover guided by a growing library of concepts. Symbolic tools retain responsibility for expression evaluation, simplification and constant fitting.
descriptions.coevo: Evolves symbolic solutions expressed as ideas, formulas and executable code. An idea tree generates candidates, while a reusable library accumulates concepts extracted from improving solutions.
descriptions.drsr: Combines equation generation with analyses of observed data, residuals and previous candidate ideas. Numerical optimization fits free parameters, and a classified idea library informs subsequent equation proposals.
descriptions.deliberate-evolution: Evolves symbolic expression structures while a numerical optimizer fits constants. A bandit selects variation operators using search state, diagnostic tools and reflective memory.
descriptions.elm: Mutates robot-generating Python programs with a language model trained on code diffs, retaining candidates in a MAP-Elites archive. Accepted mutations also provide training data for the mutation model.
descriptions.lmx: Concatenates parent genotypes as few-shot examples and parses a language model's continuation as offspring. Tournament selection or MAP-Elites then selects among candidates across different text-based genotype representations.
descriptions.evoprompting: Evolves neural architecture code through language-model crossover and mutation conditioned on parent implementations and metrics. Evaluated candidates guide both population selection and soft prompt tuning of the generator.
descriptions.qdaif: Maintains a MAP-Elites archive of texts, using language-model feedback for quality scores and diversity coordinates. Few-shot continuation or rewriting generates candidates that compete within archive cells.
descriptions.evolcaf: Evolves cost-aware acquisition functions through language-model crossover and mutation. Evaluation runs a Bayesian optimization loop where candidates use objective predictions, estimated costs and remaining budget to select observations.
descriptions.omni-epic: Generates task descriptions and executable environments from retrieved successes and failures. A model screens interestingness, an RL learner attempts accepted tasks, and the outcomes extend the task archive.
descriptions.llamea-hpo: Generates complete heuristic algorithms and their hyperparameter spaces with a language model. SMAC tunes each candidate, while fitness and execution feedback guide subsequent changes to algorithmic code.
descriptions.mind-evolution: Evolves natural-language solution plans in an island population. Critic–author dialogue refines candidates using evaluator feedback, while recombination, migration and archive resets maintain alternative solutions.
descriptions.cocoevo: Co-evolves programs and assertion tests from a task description. Program selection uses agreement with current tests, while coverage feedback generates tests selected for confidence and discrimination.
descriptions.llamea-bo: Evolves complete Bayesian optimization implementations, including surrogate models and acquisition functions. A language model performs code crossover and mutation, with population selection driven by optimization-run feedback.
descriptions.accelopt: Combines kernel beam search with planner, executor and summarizer roles. Profiling selects correct kernels, while summaries of faster and slower rewrites form memory for subsequent planning.
descriptions.eob: Evolves black-box objective functions to match target landscape characteristics and distinguish optimization algorithms. Language-model reflection guides variation, while decomposition-based evolutionary search maintains a Pareto archive.
descriptions.mce: Evolves skills for constructing task context. Each skill produces context files and retrieval code from training trajectories, and validation feedback selects skills for subsequent recombination.
descriptions.constitutional-evolution: Evolves prioritized natural-language rules governing a simulated multi-agent society. An island-based search rewrites constitutions using action logs and a score combining productivity, survival and conflict.
descriptions.ael-harness: Selects memory-retrieval policies through Thompson sampling and periodically reflects on trajectories. When progress stalls, a language model proposes new retrieval policies or planners for the pool.
descriptions.ahe: Separates coding, debugging and evolution roles to revise prompts, tools, skills and memory. Distilled execution traces guide edits whose predicted effects are checked in subsequent rounds.
descriptions.autorise: Revises a red-teaming strategy's Python implementation within a fixed evaluation harness. Each cycle records a hypothesis, tests the edit, and retains or reverts it using score feedback.
descriptions.evoor-agent: Co-evolves reasoning programs and a graph of problem-solving transitions. Weighted graph walks guide recombination, language-model mutation changes programs, and evaluation feedback updates and prunes graph edges.
descriptions.llmastool: Mutates hierarchical neural-architecture trees using modules mined from PyTorch code. A bandit selects transformation categories, deterministic rules set structural choices, and a language model supplies remaining details.
descriptions.meta-ttl: Evolves a meta-prompt controlling how an actor's system prompt changes between episodes. An outer loop uses trajectory feedback and task validation to select adaptation policies.
descriptions.enpire: Freezes a robot environment interface, then lets coding systems revise policy-training code through physical rollouts. Multiple robot workstations exchange and merge candidate training recipes through Git.
descriptions.kernelpro: Combines Monte Carlo tree search over CUDA implementations with bottleneck analysis and targeted profiling. Profiling counters, search memory and kernel-library source inspection guide subsequent code generation.
descriptions.llamea-mobo: Evolves complete multi-objective Bayesian optimization algorithms through language-model crossover and mutation. SMAC tunes each candidate's hyperparameters, and evolutionary selection uses hypervolume feedback from optimization tasks.
descriptions.llm-flowrepair: Replaces content-editing mutations in Simulink-Stateflow repair with language-model JSON patches. Structural mutations, fault localization, component selection and existing patch-search archives remain in the surrounding repair loop.
